courses.title: Building Automated Workflows
courses.description: Building Automated Workflows focuses on workflow automation for people working toward a Data Analyst role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces financial record keeping, enough to apply alongside workflow automation in real Data Analyst work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to workflow automation and show how financial record keeping supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying workflow automation to a real Data Analyst scenario
Practicing workflow automation through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to financial record keeping
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Workflow Automation Essentials
alternates.description: Workflow Automation Essentials walks you through the basics of workflow automation, built for people new to Data Analyst work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of workflow automation, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
